summary: Declare the inputs of the isolation-vm and mail-redelivery-canaries evidence checks, the same list as linux-gate (shadow only: enforce stays false), so a note signed for one tree also covers a later tree whose declared inputs are identical

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes the evidence skip policy (read from the accepted base), a test and the gate-evidence documentation.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. With enforce false nothing is skipped: the two jobs sign their input key, their records are indexed under refs/notes/evidence-input/, the gate records match=inputs lines for them, and the real jobs still run.

recovery.detail: No recovery procedure; reverting the policy hunk restores exact-tree matching for isolation-vm and mail-redelivery-canaries.
